notes.euChamp_26: Glad to have been part of such well organized event. Racing in my hometown was awesome. Descents were muddy and technical, but I enjoyed every moment of the race. Thanks to all the spectators and volunteers for the amazing atmosphere. I finished 65th.
notes.utvv_26: It was not my day, see you next year.
notes.starigrad_26: Same course as the European Championships. I managed to qualify for an up-and-down race format.
notes.farbanca_26: A time-based race rather than distance. This year I climbed the same route 9 times, totaling 24 km and 2700 m elevation gain.
notes.jatr_25: First time running a longer distance at the Julian Alps Trail Run.
notes.verbier_25: My first ultra-distance race. I entered the UTMB series race aiming to finish before nightfall, which I achieved, placing 87th.
